subject: Add ratification counterfactual analysis with 2x knock-on cascade
body:
Counterfactual: what if the US fully ratified ICESCR?

Seven ratification hypotheses (R1-R7) evaluated through discriminator.
Surviving composite R-A: Institutional Capacity + Quality Floor +
Compliance Theater, activated by Litigation.

Key findings:
- Ratification provides legal tools, not solutions
- Most effective mechanism: litigation, not executive action
- ADA pattern predicts trajectory: slow, adversarial, transformative
  over 10-20 years
- Compliance theater creates legal surface area that litigation
  activates (R-II scores 18/25, highest 2nd-order interaction)
- Ratification addresses 2 of 4 scarcities (judgment, attention)
  through legal mechanisms; 2 remain unaddressed (energy, spec)
- Quality stratification inverts in regulated sectors: legal floor
  replaces market-driven quality in healthcare/education

Advocacy reframing: "tools, not solutions" — honest, effective
across all three core audiences.

implementation options, state management hierarchy, and edge cases.
